The June 26 IRGC drone strike on Ever Lovely led Trump to call it a 'foolish violation'; CENTCOM struck four Iranian targets the same day. Iran's IRGC characterized its drone action as 'ceasefire management' under Clause 5 and issued a counter-retaliation statement. Neither side has formally declared the MOU void as of June 27. Historical base rate for formal ceasefire collapse within 7 days of a bounded violation-and-retaliation cycle: approximately 40-50%. p=0.52 reflects thin margin for framework survival.
